006package dev.metaschema.databind.model.metaschema;
007
008import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IAssemblyNodeItem;
009import dev.metaschema.core.model.IModelElement;
010import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
011
012/**
013 * Represents a Metaschema model element loaded via data binding.
014 * <p>
015 * This interface is the base type for all model elements that are loaded from
016 * Metaschema source files using data binding.
017 */
018public interface IBindingModelElement extends IModelElement {
019  @Override
020  IBindingMetaschemaModule getContainingModule();
021
022  /**
023   * Get the source node item representing this model element in the original
024   * Metaschema module.
025   * <p>
026   * This provides access to the parsed Metaschema source data that was used to
027   * create this model element.
028   *
029   * @return the source assembly node item
030   */
031  @NonNull
032  IAssemblyNodeItem getSourceNodeItem();
033}
